A1.description: M2d, the E5/E6 baseline: LadderNet, grouped input flattened, 4 residual blocks at width 480, per-country heads (64) centred, static features dropped

A2.description: A1 with uncentred country heads -- what the merged-influence view (E6.1) requires

A3.description: A1 wider and deeper: width 768, 8 residual blocks

A4.description: The shallow trunk: A1 with no residual blocks. The E6-12 / E7 line

A5.description: A4 reading the OPS_BUDGET observation block (3 floats appended; P30 C4)

A6.description: A4 plus two card/country token-attention layers, width 128 (P30 C1)

A7.description: A4 plus the branch head: branch logits corrected from the trunk and a one-hot of the resolving card (P31)

A8.description: A7 plus the play-mode head: play-mode logits corrected from the trunk and a one-hot of the card being played

A9.description: A8 plus the logit cap at 7: each legal move's logit deficit to the top legal move bounded through 7*tanh(d/7)

A10.description: A9 with the straight-through cap gradient (--ladder-logit-cap-grad straight): the same play, the raw logits' gradient as if uncapped

A11.description: A9 with a leaky cap gradient (--ladder-logit-cap-leak 0.1): the tanh's own gradient plus 0.1 x the raw one

A12.description: A9 with an upward-only cap leak (--ladder-logit-cap-leak-up 1.0): the tanh's own gradient plus the raw one where it raises a logit, weighted by tanh^2 of the deficit (from commit b5d0bf2; the unweighted first version's two runs are voided)

A13.description: A8 with the grouped input projections at 512 (256), grown in place from a 256-wide state by --resume-widen: each unit copied, the fusion layer reading each copy at 1/2

A14.description: A13 plus Cell A: each country's input to the per-country head joined with its map neighbours' mean and compared within its region by attention (width 64, 4 heads), added through a zero-initialised projection; grown in place

A15.description: A13's shape read only for its value: a P34 evaluator (value fit; the policy heads unused)

A16.description: A15 deep: width 768, 8 residual blocks (A3's trunk on A13), value only -- P34's capacity test

A17.description: A15 plus two card/country token-attention layers, width 128 (A6's), value only

A18.description: A13 plus two card/country token-attention layers of width 128 (A6s), grown at identity onto A13+R48 by --resume-grow-tokens (P35 item 1, the grown read)

A19.description: A13 read only for its policy (a P36c student: --mode policy-fit, the value heads frozen)

A20.description: A19 deep: A13 with hidden 1024 and 8 residual blocks (8.7x the parameters), policy only (a P36c student)

A21.description: P35 item 2's scaled conventional network: A8 with the grouped input projections at 512 (A13's), fusion width 480 -> 768 and 4 residual blocks, A8's heads; the box-4 observation bit (obs_features headline_reveal)

A22.description: A21 at E8's default view: the same network (A8 with 512 projections, fusion 768, 4 residual blocks, A8's heads) reading headline_reveal, which is the default from E8 on, so its flags no longer name it (main a20d77a)

A23.description: A13's trunk frozen under an action-value head (--mode q-fit): a 220-wide head fitted to the rollout root's per-candidate paired leads; the E7 network read at its own view on E8 (no observation features)

A24.description: A19 on E8 with an E7 network's view (no observation features): the X0 policy-fit student

A33.description: P35 item 1's encoder: A8 (card-conditioned heads) with two card/country token-attention layers of width 128 (A6's), at E8's default view (headline_reveal)

A34.description: A22 without dropout in its residual blocks (--ladder-res-dropout 0; the historical 0.05 otherwise): the rollouts act in eval mode and the PPO update in train mode, so with dropout the update's log-probabilities and KL are those of a policy that never played -- the leading suspect for the scaled network's failure (2026-10-22)

A25.description: A22 with a LayerNorm on the trunk output after its residual blocks and no residual dropout (--ladder-trunk-norm --ladder-res-dropout 0; owner, 2026-10-23): A22's pre-LN blocks let the trunk output grow unbounded (RMS 28.9 by 400M, A8 0.37) and the play-mode, Ops-mode and branch heads, which read it raw, reached logit spreads of thousands

A26.description: Width without depth (owner, 2026-10-23): A13's 512 grouped projections with the fusion at 768 (A8: 256 / 480), no residual blocks, so the fusion's LayerNorm bounds the trunk as in A8 -- the first step toward bigger networks after the residual-block trunk lost rank (A25; research/method/network_stability.md)

A27.description: A26 (512 projections, fusion 768) with SimbaV2's hyperspherical trunk, 2 blocks, expansion 4 (--ladder-sphere-blocks 2): the stream on the unit sphere renormalised at every block, lerp residual, unit-norm weight rows re-projected after every step -- P38 rung 2

A28.description: A27 (SimbaV2 trunk, 2 blocks, A26's width) with the trunk's output at per-element RMS 0.5 (--ladder-sphere-out-scale 0.5) instead of 1 -- the heads' input near A8's scale (P38 rung 2c)

A29.description: A26 (512 projections, fusion 768) with 2 post-LN residual blocks (--ladder-res-blocks 2 --ladder-res-post-norm --ladder-res-dropout 0): depth with the stream renormalised at every block -- P38's named fallback for the SimbaV2 trunk

A30.description: A27 (SimbaV2 trunk, 2 blocks, A26's width) with the trunk's output at per-element RMS 0.35, A8's heads' input scale (--ladder-sphere-out-scale 0.35): at RMS 1 the heads without a LayerNorm went dormant

A31.description: A8 with a LayerNorm after the first layer of the heads that had none -- the per-entity (country), branch and play-mode heads (--ladder-head-norm), as the base policy head has: the heads without one die in every network measured

A32.description: A30 (SimbaV2 trunk, 2 blocks, A26's width, output RMS 0.35) with a LayerNorm after the first layer of the per-entity, branch and play-mode heads (--ladder-head-norm)

R36.description: R32 + R34: the frozen heads soup's Gumbel improved-policy targets (search CE 0.1, k=4 @32, every node type, 1 in 8) plus the logit-gap penalty at 1e-3 (gap 7)

R37.description: P32 B4': R1 plus turn credit -- 64 learner decisions per rollout (2-12 options, half narrow spots, up to a third nested) priced over 16 worlds to the end of the turn, trained toward max(pi, 1e-3) * exp(10 Q) by evidence-weighted CE
